note: City of Miller campground at the north end of 20-acre Crystal Park on W 7th St: pull-through sites with 30/50-amp electric, no water hookups. Drinking water and a dump station at the park's south end; bathhouse/storm shelter, playground, disc golf and picnic shelter in the park. The first three nights are by free-will donation, then $30 a day. --Claude
